title: submission.rs: sort+dedup for Id deduplication should be HashSet
description: submission.rs pre-fetch loop deduplicates non_ref_ids with sort_by+dedup_by (O(n log n)). Id implements Hash+Eq+Clone, so HashSet<Id> would be O(n) and more idiomatic. Collect keys into a HashSet then iterate for the batch fetch, avoiding the sort step entirely.
